0022600094.text: The Charlotte Hornets host the Atlanta Hawks in the Hornets' second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams sitting at 1-0, Charlotte third in the Southeast and sixth in the East, and Atlanta first in the Southeast and second in the East. Charlotte won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 110-107 home win on February 11, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season between them. For the Hornets, Kylan Boswell is out with a knee injury, while Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions. For the Hawks, Henri Veesaar is out with a knee injury and Mouhamed Gueye is out with a fractured foot.
